content: Ascended Heroes (Pokemon TCG: Mega Evolution -- Ascended Heroes) released 2026-01-30. Elite Trainer Box MSRP $49.99 (9 packs + N's Zekrom promo, released 2026-02-20); Pokemon Center-exclusive ETB variant has 11 packs (out of scope, standard-retail only). Booster Bundle (6 packs) MSRP $26.94 (released 2026-04-24). Standard Booster Box MSRP not directly confirmed in this pass -- inferred ~$161.64 by pattern-match to Perfect Order/Pitch Black (same block, same pack count) -- needs confirmation at seeding time. TCGplayer product id for booster bundle: 668541.
